bfe26a84b7e6bec0.description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. Position Summary: The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R;) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be a core contributor on the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who learns our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and consistently raises the quality of what we build. Duties & Responsibilities: - Design, build, review, and debug across the stack (backend-heavy, with full-stack breadth), owning features and services end to end. - Work backward from customer pain points and business goals to make sure you're solving the right problem before writing code. - Build systems that are highly available, resilient, and easy to operate during peak-demand emergency events. - Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-scoped, achievable pieces and drive them to completion. - Design with non-functional requirements in mind availability, scalability, latency, reliability, cost, and maintainability. - Instrument your work and use metrics to guide decisions, validate impact, and improve system performance. - Partner with product, operations, and business stakeholders to align your work with real customer and business outcomes. - Anticipate failure modes and contribute to operational excellence, including readiness for surge scenarios during active storm events. - Mentor junior engineers, share knowledge, and contribute to a culture of ownership and high standards. - Leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve quality, and increase your leverage. Required Skills & Experience: - 45 years of demonstrable software development experience building production systems. - Strong proficiency in high-level programming languages such as Python, Java, or JavaScript, with backend-heavy full-stack capability. - Proven experience building highly available, maintainable, and scalable systems in production. - Solid understanding of non-functional requirements (availability, scalability, reliability, latency, cost, maintainability) and how to design for them. - A metric-driven mindset you instrument, measure, and let data drive decisions. - Strong problem-solving ability and rigorous reasoning about system behavior and trade-offs. - Ability to decompose complex, ambiguous problems into smaller, achievable deliverables. - A self-starter who operates with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. - An \"AI-ready\" engineer who actively leverages AI tools to boost productivity. Preferred Skills & Experience: - Experience building systems that operate under high-stakes, time-sensitive, or surge-driven conditions (e.g., emergency response, logistics, on-demand marketplaces, or workforce/staffing platforms). - Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). - Experience with observability, on-call, and operational excellence practices for mission-critical services. - Experience mentoring peers or junior engineers. - Exposure to workforce management, procurement, or supply/demand matching domains. - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Working Model: Hybrid: In office 1-3 days per week to foster collaboration with Engineering partners. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about .

EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: to provide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

We are building a Talent Pool for a future Business Development Specialist role based in the UK, aiming to keep strong candidates mapped for upcoming opportunities.

In this position, you would support EBANX’s global expansion by acquiring new business and forming strategic partnerships in key regions. The focus is on engaging with enterprise merchants and driving growth through centralized management and scalable solutions. As a front-runner of our expansion, you would onboard new customers, strengthen relationships, and reinforce our presence among digital clients.

This mission includes accelerating synchronized sales processes in collaboration with marketing, operations, and product teams, ensuring a seamless and strategic go-to-market approach.

Responsibilities include:

• 

Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities with merchants, expanding our market presence and revenue.

• 

Build and execute strategic plans to penetrate new verticals, regions, and customer segments.

• 

Proactively generate leads, conduct market research, and establish relationships with key stakeholders.

• 

Drive the adoption of our payment solutions, positioning the company as a preferred partner.

• 

Collaborate closely with GTM, product, marketing, merchant success, risk, legal, and finance teams to ensure seamless deal execution and client onboarding.

• 

Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements that align with business goals and drive long-term value.

• 

Consistently track pipeline progression and performance metrics within Salesforce.com.

• 

Provide market insights and feedback to leadership, helping shape business strategies, optimize the sales cycle, and refine go-to-market approaches.

• 

Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor movements, and emerging opportunities in the payment ecosystem.

• 

Represent the company with professionalism, enthusiasm, and a strong commitment to building strategic partnerships.

What is essential for the job:

• 

Proven experience in business development / strategic sales with global enterprise accounts. Experience Payments Industry required.

• 

A proven track record of meeting and exceeding business goals is highly valued.

• 

Deep knowledge of the merchant payment ecosystem (payment processing solutions, e-commerce platforms), market trends, and customer pain points.

• 

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to negotiate and close complex deals and present to senior stakeholders effectively.

• 

English language is a must. A secondary language is a plus.

• 

Proven ability to identify and generate pipeline and accelerate deals in the pipeline.

• 

Analytical mindset with attention to detail, capable of identifying and leveraging data-driven opportunities.

• 

Proven experience using Salesforce CRM to manage pipelines, forecast revenue, and drive sales process discipline.

• 

Familiarity with HubSpot for campaign tracking, lead nurturing, and marketing-to-sales alignment.

• 

Hands-on experience with modern lead generation tools, including AI-powered prospecting platforms (e.g., Apollo, Cognism, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator with AI plug-ins).

• 

Ability to translate CRM and data insights into actionable account or territory strategies.

• 

Demonstrated hunter mentality — driven by curiosity, persistence, and the thrill of landing net-new logos.

• 

Track record of consistently exceeding new logo acquisition targets in competitive or greenfield markets.

• 

Self-starter with a proactive, outbound mindset and a passion for building pipeline from scratch and managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing business needs.

• 

Exceptional communication, presentation, and persuasion skills.

• 

Excellent planning, organization, prioritization, and time management.

Must have a valid passport and be willing to travel (up to 50% of the time);

What you will do Discovery and specs • Sit in on North American customer calls, capture problems and turn them into clear problem statements • Write PRDs and user stories for features across TMS, transporter and driver apps • Run usability sessions with dispatchers, transporters and drivers, and feed findings back into specs Delivery • Work with engineering and design through sprint cycles; own backlog grooming for your features • Test releases before they ship and write release notes customers actually read • Track adoption after launch and propose the next iteration Data and integrations • Define metrics for your features and build the dashboards to track them (SQL, Metabase) • Map customer integration needs (ERP, telematics, ePOD) and document requirements for the integrations team North America customers and GTM • Support onboarding and product questions for North American accounts during their business hours • Feed North America-specific requirements and competitive insights into the roadmap • Help Sales with demos and product collateral What we are looking for • Final-year student or recent graduate (engineering, business or design), or 0 to 1 years in a product, analyst or founder role • Evidence you have built or shipped something: a side project, hackathon, campus product or a public teardown • Comfortable with SQL/ mongoDB basics and spreadsheets; can pull your own numbers • Clear written communication; your PRD should survive without you in the room • Curious about logistics and willing to spend time with drivers and dispatchers, not just dashboards • Able to work North America hours (approx. 6 pm to 3 am IST) from our Bengaluru office for six months

bf94211b2059041c.description: Company Description International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIITH) is an autonomous, not-for-profit research university founded in 1998 as Indias first IIIT under a publicprivate partnership model. The institute is known for strong, technology-focused research programs that address real-world needs of industry and society, supported by several world-renowned centers of excellence. IIITH emphasizes interdisciplinary work, collaboration, and co-innovation with national and multinational partners, giving learners exposure to cutting-edge projects and industrial ecosystems. Its flexible curriculum allows students to choose courses and projects that match their interests, while a vibrant campus environment supports arts, sports, societal engagement, and self-governance. Even undergraduate students are actively involved in ongoing research and technology development, creating a dynamic community where early-career talent can learn alongside experienced researchers. Role Description The Intern role at IIITH is a full-time, hybrid position based in Hyderabad, with some flexibility for work from home depending on project needs. Interns will support faculty, researchers, or project leads through tasks such as data collection, literature review, documentation, and preparation of reports or presentations. Daily activities may include assisting in experiment design or implementation, contributing to prototypes or tools, organizing project resources, and helping maintain research or project documentation. Interns will collaborate with mentors and team members, attend relevant meetings or seminars, and participate in periodic reviews of project progress. The role is designed to provide hands-on exposure to academic research and technology development, while building professional skills in a structured, learning-focused environment. Qualifications Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with capacity to learn new concepts and tools quickly. Basic familiarity with research workflows (e.g., literature surveys, data organization, documentation), or willingness to learn under guidance. Effective written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with faculty, researchers, and peers. Ability to work both independently and in teams, manage time well, and meet agreed timelines in a full-time hybrid setup. Enrollment in or completion of a relevant undergraduate or postgraduate program (such as Computer Science, Engineering, Sciences, or related fields) is preferred. Comfort with using common productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., office suites, online communication platforms, version control or shared document tools) is an advantage. Demonstrated interest in research, technology development, or academic projects through coursework, personal projects, or prior internships is beneficial. .
